unit.why: A chain-of-transmission report of a saying by R. Israel of Ruzhin praising the Kozhnitzer Maggid's body as having the brightness of a thousand Jewish souls. There is no narrated event, only the saying and its setting on the eve of the yahrzeit.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of praises of the Kozhnitzer Maggid; previous and next divisions are separate items.
